headline: Anthropic starts trading on Nasdaq today as crypto platforms roll out tokens that track its shares, while bitcoin sits near $63,000 with fear at extreme lows after the Fed pointed to a December rate rise.

market.asOf: Read at about 04:00-04:05 UTC Thu 19 Nov (about 11:00 Bangkok) on CoinGecko's homepage. CoinMarketCap showed similar prices (BTC about $62,600-63,430, ETH about $1,770-1,789, SOL about $73.15-74.17). The two sites did not agree on the size or direction of the 24-hour move, so it is left out here. Prices move fast; use the live prices on this page.
market.fearGreed: Extreme fear: alternative.me's Crypto Fear & Greed Index 11 (12 yesterday, 29 a week ago, 59 a month ago), read at about 04:01 UTC Thu 19 Nov; CoinMarketCap's own Fear & Greed Index also 11, read at about 04:03 UTC.

stories.title: Anthropic debuts on Nasdaq today, and crypto platforms launch tokens that track its shares
stories.summary: AI company Anthropic priced its shares at $83, above its $70-78 range, and starts trading on Nasdaq as ANT on Thursday. Crypto platforms including Ondo, Binance Wallet, Kraken and Bitget are offering tokens that track the share price. These tokens do not make you a shareholder, and some are not open to US residents.
points: Anthropic priced at $83 a share, above its target range of $70 to $78, per Yahoo; trading is due to begin Thursday at 9:30 a.m. ET, per CBS News.
The deal values Anthropic at about $1.5 trillion with 980 million shares raising about $81 billion, per PBS NewsHour.
CZ said tokenized Anthropic goes live on BNB Chain on listing day; a Binance Wallet pre-IPO campaign with a 500 million USDC cap filled within hours, per CoinDesk.
Ondo is launching a token tracking ANT for eligible investors outside the US only, per The Block.
Pre-IPO perpetual futures traded between about $96 and $99 on Wednesday morning, roughly 24% to 27% above the top of the range, per Yahoo Finance.

sources.label: CoinDesk: tokenized Anthropic on BNB Chain
Yahoo Finance: crypto lines up tokenized Anthropic

stories.title: Fed minutes point to a December rate rise, and Waller floats a half-point move
stories.summary: Minutes of the Fed's October meeting show nearly all officials expect to raise interest rates again, and Fed Governor Waller said a bigger half-point rise may be needed. Higher rates tend to pull money away from riskier assets like crypto, and gold and silver also fell.
points: Nearly all officials judged further rate rises appropriate, per the Fed minutes as reported by BigGo Finance; the Fed's range is 3.75%-4%.

CME FedWatch showed a 92.7% chance of a quarter-point rise in December and 7.3% for a half point, per BigGo Finance; 24/7 Wall St put the chance of a quarter-point rise at about 96% on 18 Nov, with the rest on a half point.
Waller said inflation is 'headed in the wrong direction, and it's spreading out', per CoinReporter.
Spot gold fell 3.24% to $3,724.71 an ounce, its lowest since September 2025, and silver fell 4.92% to $45.06, per BigGo Finance.

sources.label: BigGo Finance: Fed minutes and FedWatch

stories.title: Bitcoin hovers near $62,000-63,000 as fear stays extreme and fund outflows continue
stories.summary: Bitcoin slipped after the Fed minutes and briefly fell below 10 million yen (about $62,000) in early Asian trading, close to last weekend's lows. Money keeps leaving US bitcoin funds, and the crowd-mood index is near its lowest reading.
points: Bitcoin was $62,675.46, down 2.7% in 24 hours, and ether $1,773.65, down 1.8%, per CoinGecko data at 01:30 UTC cited by CoinGabbar.
Bitcoin briefly fell below 10 million yen in the early hours of 19 Nov, about $62,000, per BigGo Finance.
US spot bitcoin ETFs had a $239.9 million net outflow on Tuesday 17 Nov, including $209.5 million from BlackRock's IBIT, per TFTC; Wednesday's figures were not out at the time of writing.
November's spot bitcoin ETF outflows total almost $2.6 billion, per KuCoin's daily report.
About $150.06 million of bitcoin futures were liquidated in 24 hours as of Wednesday afternoon, 74% of them long bets, per CoinGlass data cited by CoinReporter.

briefs.title: Hijacked web scripts swapped crypto wallet addresses
briefs.summary: Attackers abused an Optimizely flaw to inject code into 178 organizations' sites, including Ledger's, that swapped copied crypto addresses; researchers traced about $7,040 to the attacker, and Optimizely says the flaw is fixed, per The Hacker News.

briefs.title: Backpack completes its US licences
briefs.summary: Backpack won NFA approval as a futures commission merchant, completing the regulatory set it needs for planned US perpetual futures, per The Block.

briefs.title: Strategy buys 485 more bitcoin
briefs.summary: Strategy bought 485 BTC for $33.4 million over 9-15 Nov, bringing its holdings to 850,849 BTC at an average cost of $75,452, per its SEC filing.

briefs.title: Binance wins $6.5B freezing order over October hack
briefs.summary: Abu Dhabi courts granted a worldwide freezing order as Binance tries to recover crypto stolen in its October hack, per The Block.

briefs.title: Kraken's parent agrees to buy Tribe Capital
briefs.summary: Payward is acquiring Tribe Capital to expand its private-market offerings, per The Block.

briefs.title: Bullish profit rises
briefs.summary: Bullish's Q3 adjusted profit rose 35% while digital-asset sales fell 23%, per The Block.

briefs.title: Banks test tokenized deposits across networks
briefs.summary: Standard Chartered, StraitsX and OCBC completed a proof-of-concept linking the banks' separate tokenized deposit networks, with StraitsX's system settling payments between them, per The Block.

calendar.event: US jobless claims and Philly Fed survey
calendar.note: Claims forecast 196,000, prior 200,000; Philly Fed forecast 20.6, prior 20.9, per Finviz. Walmart reports at 7:00am ET, per Walmart via Finviz. Fed's Hammack speaks at 8:50am ET, per Finviz, and Vice Chair Jefferson at 9:25am ET, per the Fed.

calendar.event: Anthropic's first day of trading on Nasdaq as ANT
calendar.note: Priced at $83, above the $70-78 range, per TechCrunch; trading begins at 9:30am ET, per CBS News.

SEC nominees Kristin N. Johnson and Steven Levine appear before the Senate Banking Committee with other nominees, per the committee's page. Fed's Goolsbee (12:30pm ET), Barkin (4:00pm ET) and Paulson (6:30pm ET) speak, per Finviz, and Barr at 2:15pm ET, per the Fed.

calendar.event: Weekly bitcoin options expiry on Deribit
calendar.note: Options expire at 08:00 UTC. About 28,300 BTC (around $1.8B) of options, per CryptoTicker's 14 Nov figures. The bigger monthly expiry is Fri 27 Nov.

calendar.event: University of Michigan consumer sentiment (Nov, final)
calendar.note: Forecast 52, per Finviz; the preliminary November reading was 51.0, per StockAnalysis. Fed's Waller speaks at 8:25am ET and Cook at 12:15pm ET (00:15 Sat Bangkok), per the Fed.
Prior 91.7, per Finviz. Workday, Dell and HP report after the US close, per IfYouSpent.

calendar.event: US GDP (Q3 second estimate), PCE inflation (Oct), durable goods and jobless claims
calendar.note: GDP forecast 3.4%, the same as the advance estimate, per Finviz and the BEA. PCE prior 3.6% a year (core 3.1%), per the BEA. Weekly jobless claims are also due Wednesday at 8:30am ET, per FinanceCalendar. Fed Beige Book at 2:00pm ET, per the Fed.

calendar.event: Thanksgiving: US stock market closed, then early close
calendar.note: NYSE closed Thursday and closes at 1:00pm ET Friday, per NYSE. A monthly bitcoin options expiry on Deribit is Friday at 08:00 UTC, per CryptoTicker.

calendar.event: Next Fed meeting and rate decision
calendar.note: Decision Wed 9 Dec at 2:00pm ET (02:00 Thu Bangkok), per the Fed. On 18 Nov CME FedWatch showed about a 96% chance of a quarter-point rise with the rest on a half point, per 24/7 Wall St; BigGo Finance reported 92.7% for a quarter point and 7.3% for a half point.
